title: Website presentation

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study
location.extent: Published video poster and complete associated clip

slide_intent: Carry an identity into navigation and promotion, because visitors need useful information as well as a memorable first impression.
strategic_value: Stable museum navigation paired with changing specimens and exhibition colors can connect distinct offers within one digital destination.
demonstration: A browser mockup cycles from a beetle hero and curved phrase to Volcano and Dino VR promotions, a specimen on acid yellow and a WONDER composition.
practical_value: Compare stable navigation with changing exhibition imagery, title scale and action strips.

content_islands.name: Browser frame and navigation
content_islands.spec: Keep the browser and museum navigation above the hero content.

content_islands.name: Changing hero
content_islands.spec: Sequence beetle, volcano, flying reptile and specimen views.

content_islands.name: Exhibition information
content_islands.spec: Pair selected scenes with dates and booking controls in a colored lower strip.
